collection.label: Daodejing (Mawangdui silk manuscripts)
collection.author_name: Laozi (Mawangdui Tomb 3 silk manuscripts, before 168 BCE)
collection.critical_edition: Changsha Mawangdui Han mu jianbo jicheng (2014) column numbers; Wikisource transcription; Wang Bi received text
collection.edition_label: Received text (Wang Bi recension), the text Legge translated
collection.search_terms: daodejing tao te ching laozi lao tzu mawangdui silk dao de
collection.description: The Daodejing chapter by chapter on the two Mawangdui silk manuscripts (copied before 168 BCE), the oldest nearly complete copies, with the column-by-column transcription, the received Wang Bi text and James Legge's English.
